Gate Base Class

Source: R/Gate.R
Gate.Rd

Abstract base class for diagnostic gates in the AutoIML workflow.

Gates operate on a context environment that includes:

  • task: mlr3::Task

  • learner: mlr3::Learner (cloned for safety)

  • resampling: mlr3::Resampling

  • rr: mlr3::ResampleResult (if already computed)

  • final_model: trained learner (optional)

  • pred: merged mlr3::Prediction object (optional)

  • purpose: scalar purpose string

  • quick_start: logical flag

  • seed: integer seed (optional)

Concrete gate implementations inherit from this class and override the run() method.

Developed by Stefan Coors, Clara Vetter, Jonas Hauck, Bernd Bischl, Sven Hilbert.
